Campaign
========

From Dungeon Defenders 2 Wiki

Jump to: [navigation](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Campaign#mw-head)
, [search](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Campaign#p-search)

The Campaign introduces the player to Dungeon Defenders 2. Campaign maps can be played in either Normal or Hard mode. After completing the Campaign, players should make their way over to [Adventures](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adventures "Adventures")
, followed by [Expeditions](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Expeditions "Expeditions")
.

The first 3 maps in Normal mode serve as the Tutorial for the game. When playing these maps your Hero Deck will be altered for the Tutorial. These changes are not permanent.

World Map
---------

[![WorldmapCampaign.jpg](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/d7/WorldmapCampaign.jpg)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:WorldmapCampaign.jpg)

Maps
----

### The Gates of Dragonfall

[![TheGatesofDragonfall MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/6/66/TheGatesofDragonfall_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:TheGatesofDragonfall_MapIcon.png)

A cart transporting an Eternia Crystal has collapsed outside of the gates of Dragonfall. Now those gates are closed and the Old Ones' armies seek to destroy the Crystal.

### Dragonfall Bazaar

[![DragonfallBazaar MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/c5/DragonfallBazaar_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:DragonfallBazaar_MapIcon.png)

Normally a bustling center of trade, the Dragonfall Bazaar has been overrun by the Old Ones' army, with one merchant refusing to budge.

### Greystone Plaza

[![GreystonePlaza MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/05/GreystonePlaza_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:GreystonePlaza_MapIcon.png)

Greystone Plaza is normally abuzz with celebration and merriment, but now it is host to the Old Ones' army as they bombard the massive gates that protect the innermost part of Dragonfall.

### The Ramparts

[![TheRamparts MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/f/f1/TheRamparts_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:TheRamparts_MapIcon.png)

A small force has broken through the Dragonfall defenses and is making their way towards the Ramparts. Stop them before they reach the Throne Room!

### The Throne room

[![TheThroneRoom MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b7/TheThroneRoom_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:TheThroneRoom_MapIcon.png)

Some of our foes have slipped through and are threatening the Dragonfall royal family and Eternia Crystal. Hold the line or all is lost!

### Forest Crossroads

[![ForestCrossroads MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/6/6c/ForestCrossroads_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:ForestCrossroads_MapIcon.png)

A group of Talongaurd have been ambushed while escorting one of the few remaining Eternia Crystals! Help defend the crystal before the horde army manages to destroy it, releasing the chaotic power within.

### Liferoot forest

[![LiferootForest MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/0c/LiferootForest_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:LiferootForest_MapIcon.png)

A mysterious creature has shot down one of the Defense Council's important transport ships! Make your way through the depths of this ancient Forest and Protect the precious cargo inside.

### The Wyvern Den

[![TheWyvernDen MapIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/a7/TheWyvernDen_MapIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:TheWyvernDen_MapIcon.png)

Make your way into the cavernous lairs of the Wyvern Mother to recover the mysterious ancient creature eggs.

=======
